fichas.title: Kitchens
fichas.summary: Kitchen planning should support efficient work through suitable arrangement of appliances, shelves and worktops. Opposing worktops can enable two people to work in the same area. Position storage for comfortable reach and set worktop heights to suit activities. Plan for access, cleaning, lighting, ventilation, switches, sockets and built-in installations. Illustrations show work layouts, sink and worktop heights, ventilation, and kitchen-dining connections.

Working processes
The layout of a kitchen should enable rational and time-saving
working. In addition to a suitable arrangement of appliances, shelves
and worktops ---7 p. 149, working processes can also be optimised
and accelerated with opposing worktops ---7 0. The kitchen can
also be used by two people at the same time in the same area if the
worktops and appliances are appropriately arranged ---7 f).

High cupboards and shelves should be suitably positioned relative

Working processes
The layout of a kitchen should enable rational and time-saving
working. In addition to a suitable arrangement of appliances, shelves
and worktops ---7 p. 149, working processes can also be optimised
and accelerated with opposing worktops ---7 0. The kitchen can
also be used by two people at the same time in the same area if the
worktops and appliances are appropriately arranged ---7 f).

High cupboards and shelves should be suitably positioned relative
to the working areas and should be comfortable to reach ---7 0 0. Worktops placed at the correct height for the relevant activity
